search.title: Search
search.noneText: The search looks at title, note, tags and link; completed ones only with “Include completed”.

members.title: Members
members.removeText: {{name}} loses access to the space and its lists at once. Only a new invitation brings them back.
members.rolesHint: Managers invite, remove and change the space. Members may do everything with lists and tasks.
members.inviteText: A link for one person, valid for 7 days. Whoever opens it signs in or creates an account and is then in the space.
members.mailText: nextasks sends the link to this address. It works once, for 7 days.
members.leaveText: You no longer see the space’s lists afterwards. You only get back in with a new invitation.

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.noLists: No list yet. Add a list

server.languagesHint: German and English are built in. Add more as a JSON file; missing texts fall back to English.
server.stripLocation: Remove location and device from photos
server.stripLocationHint: Phones write into every photo where it was taken and with what. On by default.
server.languageAdded: Language added. It shows under Settings › Profile › Language after reloading.
server.filesHint: Files on tasks: how large they may be and what is removed when uploading.

app.invitesHint: Off: managers can no longer create invitation links.

server.backupHolds: Tasks, files and the database in one archive. Restoring shows a dry run first.
server.restoreChanges: A restore would add {{add}}, change {{change}} and remove {{remove}}.
server.featuresHint: What every account may use in nextasks.
server.mailText: Through this server nextasks sends invitations, links to confirm and for a new password, notices about your account, “My day”, the weekly report and notifications about tasks and comments.
server.whatYouSee: As the operator you see names, sign-in, role, when an account was last there, how many spaces it has and its API keys, but never the tasks, notes, comments or attachments of other accounts.

errors.assignee_no_access: This person cannot work in this space.
errors.last_list: A space keeps at least one list.
errors.not_for_you: This part is not meant for you.
errors.to_self: You do not hand anything to yourself.

errors.comment_too_long: A comment has at most 5000 characters.

errors.token_reads_only: This API key only reads. For changes, create one that writes under Connections › API keys.
errors.bad_preference: This value is not one nextasks offers.
errors.display_name_too_long: The display name is too long, at most {{maximum}} characters.
errors.log_level_from_environment: The log level is fixed by NEXTASKS_LOG_LEVEL.
errors.invalid_status: This is not a status nextasks knows.
errors.invalid_priority: This is not a priority nextasks knows.
errors.origin_refused: The API is for programs, not for web pages.

errors.app_too_many_pairings: Five codes are waiting already. Cancel one or wait ten minutes.
errors.not_signed_in: You are not signed in (any more).

login.title: Sign in
login.ended: Your session was ended, for example because your account was blocked or signed out everywhere. Sign in again.

code.title: Second factor
code.text: The code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.intoSpace: You are invited into the space “{{space}}” ({{role}}).
invite.invalidText: This invitation is not valid any more: it was used, expired or was withdrawn. Ask for a new one.
invite.noWay: Sign-in with a password is off and no sign-in provider is set up. Ask the operator.
invite.haveAccount: This link is for a new account. You are signed in as {{name}} already and do not need it.
invite.expiredText: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.

reset.doneText: Sign in with the new password now.
reset.invalidText: This link has been used or no longer works. Ask the operator for a new one.
reset.expiredText: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.

space.name: Name
space.newHint: You manage the new space and invite others by link. Everyone in a space sees all its lists.
space.prefsText: Hidden spaces are left out of the sidebar, the collections and the search. Notifications and reminders keep coming. The setting is yours only, on all your devices.
space.deleteText: The space goes to the trash with all its lists and tasks, for every member. Its managers can bring it back from there for 30 days.

sidebarPrefs.title: Sidebar
sidebarPrefs.text: Which collections and filters the sidebar shows. Hidden filters stay here and can still be edited. The setting is yours only, on all your devices.
sidebarPrefs.noFilters: No filter of your own yet.

about.subtitle: Tasks for families and small groups, on your own server.

updates.whatGoesOut: Only the question goes out: a request to api.github.com for the newest release of nextasks, with no names, tasks or settings. It is the only call nextasks makes on its own.

password.done: Password changed. Other browsers have to sign in again.

sessions.done: Every other browser is signed out.

me.setupFirst: The operator requires a second factor. Set it up here, then you can go on.
me.emailTaken: The address from your provider is now your account’s.
me.emailDeclined: This address will not be offered to you again.

twofactor.provider: You sign in through the provider; its second factor applies.
twofactor.scan: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then enter the code the app shows, and your password.
twofactor.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twofactor.passwordHint: Proves it is you at the keyboard.
twofactor.codesLead: Each one signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now: copy them or save them as a file, and keep them apart from the phone.
twofactor.renewText: The old recovery codes stop working. Enter your password to create new ones.
twofactor.disableText: From then on the password alone signs you in. Enter it to turn the second factor off.
twofactor.lowCodes: Few recovery codes left. Create new ones while you can still sign in.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.text: The key ? opens the list anywhere too.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted things stay here for 30 days, then they are gone for good.

emptyLine.scheduled: Tasks with a date show here, day by day.
emptyLine.all: All done. Type new tasks in the line below.
emptyLine.flagged: Mark a task with F or with the bookmark on its row.
emptyLine.assigned: Tasks someone assigns to you show here.
emptyLine.done: What you tick off shows here, the latest first.

copy.title: Copy “{{name}}”
copy.name: {{name}} (copy)
copy.hint: Sections and tasks come along, all open. Files stay with the old list.

reopen.title: Open “{{name}}” again?
reopen.text_one: The done task becomes open again, for the next trip, say.
reopen.text_other: All {{count}} done tasks become open again, for the next trip, say.

someday.title: Someday
someday.sub: Open and without a date, from all spaces
someday.emptyLine: What has no date waits here. “Someday” in a task's menu takes its date away.
someday.hidden: “Someday” is hidden on this device. Bring it back under Settings › Appearance › Sidebar.

sweep.title: Look back
sweep.sub: Old and overdue tasks, one after the other
sweep.keys: Keys: K, N, S, Del. Keep leaves a task alone for 30 days; repeating ones come only when they are overdue.
sweep.repeatSomeday: A repeating task keeps its date; without one its repetition would be lost.
sweep.emptyLine: Nothing has lain unchanged for over 14 days, nothing is overdue.
sweep.failed: The look back could not be loaded.

filter.name: Name
filter.conditionsHint: Every chosen condition must match; within one, any value will do. What is not chosen does not count.
filter.placeGone_one: One chosen place no longer exists.
filter.tooLong: Too many conditions: at most 4000 characters together.
filter.deleteText: The filter is deleted for good. The tasks it shows stay where they are.
filter.emptyText: As soon as a task matches the conditions, it shows here.

sync.failed: The server does not answer as expected.
sync.offline_one: No connection. One change is waiting.
sync.serverOld: This server does not know the new interface yet (/api/app/1). It needs an update.

notice.forbidden: You may not do that here. The server keeps its version.
notice.not_found: This is gone, or you no longer see it.
notice.invalid: The server did not accept the change. Its version stands.
notice.gone: This was deleted for good in the meantime.
notice.already_done: Already completed, probably on another device.
notice.due_changed: The due date changed in the meantime. Completing was dropped.
notice.parent_missing: Its list is missing on the server. The change was dropped.
notice.moved_to_private: Its list is missing on the server. The task is now in “{{list}}”.
notice.dropped_assignees_one: One person is not in the space and was not assigned.
notice.dropped_assignees_other: {{count}} people are not in the space and were not assigned.
notice.space_left: You are no longer in the space “{{name}}”.
notice.space_left_copied_one: You are no longer in that space. Your unsent change is kept as a copy in “{{list}}”.
notice.space_left_copied_other: You are no longer in that space. {{count}} tasks with unsent changes are kept as copies in “{{list}}”.
notice.upload_lost: The file “{{name}}” was lost when the page reloaded. Please attach it again.
notice.too_large: That was too large for the server.
notice.invalid_input: The server could not read the change.

look.iconSearch: Search symbols, such as shopping or dog
look.hexWrong: Enter the colour as #rrggbb, for example #1e3a8a.
look.title: Symbol and colour

list.name: Name
list.moveHint: The list moves to the other space with all its tasks. Assignments to people who are not members there are dropped.
list.cleared_one: One completed task is in the trash.
list.cleared_other: {{count}} completed tasks are in the trash.
list.notifyHint: You get a notification when others add or complete something here.
list.deleteText: The list goes to the trash with all its tasks. It stays there for 30 days and can be restored.
list.emptyText: Type your first task in the line below, Enter adds it.
list.deleteSectionText: The section is deleted for good. Its tasks stay in the list, without a section.
list.emptyShared: Everyone in “{{space}}” sees what you add here. Type the first task in the line below.

reminder.paneToggle: Show or hide the details in the side column
reminder.paneToggleFor: Show or hide the details of “{{title}}” in the side column

detail.label: Details of the task
detail.title: Title
detail.urlBad: A link starts with http://, https:// or mailto:.
detail.placeHint: A location is set in the iPhone app.
detail.assigneesHint: One is enough: whoever completes it first completes it for everyone.
detail.removeFileText: The file goes from the task and from the server.
detail.emptyFile: An empty file cannot be attached.
detail.notesNeedTitle: Pictures can be added once the task has a title.
detail.notesTooLong: The note is longer than {{max}} characters and is not saved like this.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.fromDueText: The next date follows the plan, even when you tick it off later.
repeat.fromCompletionText: The next date counts from the day you tick it off.

zone.title: Time zone
zone.text: Times of tasks count in this time zone, notifications too.

push.denied: The browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.
push.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad, notifications in the browser only arrive when nextasks is on the Home Screen as an app (Share › Add to Home Screen).
push.deniedShort: Blocked in this browser, see below.

pwa.title: As an app
pwa.text: Installed, nextasks starts like an app: in its own window without the browser bar, with its own icon, and also offline.
pwa.asked: The browser asked. If you agreed, nextasks is among your apps.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone and iPad: Share › Add to Home Screen.
pwa.update: A new version of nextasks is here.
pwa.offline: No connection to the server. nextasks keeps trying and loads as soon as the network is back.
pwa.installed: nextasks runs as an app on this device already.
pwa.firefox: Firefox cannot install web apps. Chrome, Edge or Safari can.
pwa.other: This browser does not offer installing right now. In Chrome and Edge it is in the menu, in Safari under Share.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.lead: Choose what nextasks sends you, and which way.

mail.title: Mail
mail.text: nextasks only mails an address you confirmed through a link.
mail.pending: A link is on its way to {{address}} and works until {{until}}. Until you open it, the previous address stays in use.
mail.sent: Link sent to {{address}}. Open it to confirm the address.
mail.suggestion: Your sign-in provider knows you as {{address}}.
mail.noPublic: Mail needs the public address of nextasks; the operator enters it under Server › Sign-in.
mail.removed: Address removed. nextasks no longer sends you mail.
mail.inProfile: Change the address in your profile

notify.reportsText: A report with nothing in it is not sent.
notify.dailyText: Every day: what is overdue, what is due today, and what was newly assigned to you since the last report.
notify.weeklyText: Once a week: what was done in your spaces, also by others, and what is due in the next seven days.
notify.zone: Times are in your time zone {{zone}}. You can change it in your profile.

events.assigned: A task was assigned to me
events.due: A task with a time is due
events.changed: Others change something in lists I follow
events.joined: Someone joined one of my spaces

notify.changedHint: Choose the lists you follow in the list itself with “{{label}}”.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm mail address
confirmEmail.done: Confirmed. nextasks now sends mail to {{email}}.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.done: Unsubscribed. You can turn it on again under Settings › Notifications.

join.title: Invitation
join.text: You are invited to the space “{{space}}”.
join.already: You are a member already. To the space
join.unknownText: The invitation has expired, was used or withdrawn. Ask for a new link.

connect.title: Connect iPhone
connect.text: The nextasks app wants to connect with your account.
connect.textNamed: “{{device}}” wants to connect with your account.

menu.hideInPane: Take out of the side column

columns.hint: Drag or use the arrow keys to change the width; double-click to reset it.

notFound.page: There is no such page in nextasks.
notFound.list: This list does not exist (any more), or you cannot see it.
notFound.filter: This filter does not exist (any more).

section.title: Devices
section.text: iPhone and iPad with the nextasks app.
section.disconnectText: From now on the device cannot reach your tasks. To connect it again, scan a new code.

connect.title: Connect iPhone or iPad
connect.step1: Open nextasks on the iPhone or iPad.
connect.step2: Tap “Connect a server” and scan the code.
connect.step3: Done. Your tasks load, and the sign-in travels to your other devices through your Apple ID.
connect.noCamera: Without a camera: in the app under “Code”, enter the address {{host}} and the code {{code}}.

review.title: Review
review.streakHint: at least one task every day · record {{record}}
review.streakKeep: one more today to keep it · record {{record}}
review.onTimeHint: done on or before the due day
review.onTimeNone: nothing with a due date done
review.heatLabel: Heat map: tasks done per day over the last 12 months
review.whoLabel: Stacked bars: tasks done per person, by list
review.nothingHere: Nothing was done in this period.
review.whenLabel: Dot chart: tasks done by weekday and hour
review.whenPeak: Most gets ticked off on {{weekday}} around {{hour}}.
review.pulseSub: the last 16 dates · letter = who did it
review.pulseNone: No repeating tasks with done dates yet.
review.emptyText: Once tasks get ticked off, the review shows here what got done: per day, per list and who took on what.
review.emptyTextAlone: Once you tick off tasks, the review shows here what you got done: per day, per list, your streaks and records.
review.yearTeaser: The year on one card: how much you all got done, the strongest month, the longest streak.
review.yearTeaserAlone: The year on one card: how much you got done, your strongest month, your longest streak.

year.title: Your {{year}}
year.doneFamily: tasks you all got done together in {{year}}
year.saveFailed: The picture could not be saved.
year.label: Year card {{year}}
year.emptyText: The year card fills up with every task done.

week.label: The next seven days
week.dropHint: Click to open the day in Scheduled. Drop a task here to move it to this day.

focus.title: Focus for today
focus.hint: Drag a task here or pick it with the star in its row.
focus.full: The focus has three tasks already
focus.order: Drag, or Alt + arrow keys, to change the order

family.title: Family today
family.none: Nothing is due for anyone today.

yourWeek.title: Your week
yourWeek.label: Done on the last seven days: {{counts}}

tomorrow.title: Tomorrow
tomorrow.none: Nothing is planned for tomorrow yet.

plan.title: Plan tomorrow
plan.trashAllText: They go to the trash. They stay there for 30 days before they are deleted for good.
plan.repeatKeeps: A repeating task keeps its date

comments.title: History
comments.empty: Nothing has happened yet. Be the first to write something about this task.
comments.keys: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, @ mentions someone.
comments.removeText: Everybody then sees “Message deleted” in place of the text.
comments.tooLong: A comment has at most {{max}} characters.
comments.pictureTooLarge: The picture is empty or larger than the server takes.

notify.comment: Someone comments on a task I created or am assigned to
notify.mention: Someone mentions me in a comment

rotation.hint: Whoever ticks it off had the turn. Then the next one in the row is in charge.
rotation.onlyRepeating: Taking turns works for repeating tasks.

accounts.removeTasks_one: Tasks stay in their spaces; the account is in one space.
accounts.removeTasks_other: Tasks stay in their spaces; the account is in {{count}} spaces.
